intents.hardship: Financial hardship (job loss, illness, cannot cover essentials).
intents.dispute: "This isn't my debt" or "I never had that product".
intents.restructure: A request for a payment plan or lower instalments.
intents.too_much: The customer says the full amount is too much.

lines.opening: Hello, this is Isla, a digital assistant calling from Glenmorrow Savings Bank. We record this call.
lines.robot: Yes, I'm Isla, a digital assistant calling from Glenmorrow Savings Bank.
lines.scam: I understand your caution. I will never ask you for your PIN or your full card number, and you can always contact Glenmorrow Savings Bank directly using the number on our website.
lines.purpose_before_verify: I can explain once I know I'm speaking with the right person. First I need to ask you two security questions.
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I can't share any details about that.
lines.not_talk_once: I understand, this will only take a few minutes.
lines.tp_ask: When would be a good time to reach {title} {last_name}?
lines.tp_ask_time: What time would suit, between 9 am and 6:30 pm, today or on the next two working days?
lines.tp_outside_window: I'm sorry, I can only arrange a call between 9 am and 6:30 pm, today or on the next two working days. Is there another time that would work?
lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can only discuss this with {title} {last_name}.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you. We will call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.wrong_number: Thank you for letting me know, and sorry to have bothered you.
lines.condolence: I'm very sorry for your loss.
lines.id_intro: Before we go on, I need to ask you two security questions.
lines.id_why: We ask these questions to make sure we only speak about your details with you.
lines.id_declined: I understand. Without these answers I can't go any further on this call.
lines.id_repeat: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you repeat it, please?
lines.id_wrong: I'm sorry, that doesn't match our records.
lines.id_failed: I'm sorry, I can't go any further on this call. Please visit a branch or use online banking.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you, {title} {last_name}. I'm calling about overdue payments on your account.
lines.product_line: Your {name} is {amount} in arrears, {days} days overdue.
lines.ask_today: Can you pay the full {amount} today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Can you pay both in full today?
lines.offer_floor_date: Could you pay at least {amount} on {date}?
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, I can't record an amount below {floor}.
lines.date_past: I'm sorry, that date has already passed. Which date would work for you?
lines.not_business_day: That day isn't a business day. The next business day is {date}. Would that work for you?
lines.after_deadline: I'm sorry, the latest date I can accept is {date}. Could you pay by then?
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day would that be?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which date could you pay {amount}?
lines.repeat_offer: Just to repeat, could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.readback_intro: Let me read back what we agreed.
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the latest date I can accept is {date}.
lines.confirm_q: Do you confirm this, yes or no?
lines.recorded: Thank you, your promise has been recorded.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, your promise could not be recorded because of a technical problem.
lines.paid_line: Thank you. Payments can take two business days to show, so I won't ask you for a payment on this product.
lines.dispute_line: I understand. I won't ask you for a payment on this product.
lines.hardship: I'm very sorry to hear that. I'm passing you to our care team, who can help you.
lines.restructure_line: I'll put you through to our arrears solutions team, who can talk to you about a payment plan.
lines.human_ask_help: Before I transfer you, is there anything I can help you with myself?
lines.transfer: I'm transferring you now. Please hold.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.promise_change: I'm sorry, I can't change a promise once it's saved on this call.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
lines.below_floor_final: I'm sorry, I can't record less than {amount}.
lines.confirm_again: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Do you confirm, yes or no?
lines.callback_failed: I'm sorry, I couldn't book that call back because of a technical problem.
lines.transfer_failed: I'm sorry, the transfer didn't go through.
lines.system_error: I'm sorry, our system isn't responding right now.

assumptions: Memo of 19 Oct 2026 overrides policy v3.2 where they differ (email and memo both say so).
Memo A: early band changed to 1-14 days, mid to 15-30; late 31-60 unchanged. Total attempts per band are unchanged (early 1, mid 2, late 3).
Memo B: 2026-12-11 added to holidays and treated exactly like a bank holiday (no promises, no callbacks, skipped when counting business days). 24 Dec 2026 stays a business day.
Memo C: reason code 'refused' retired. 'declined' is used as both the close_call reason and the add_note reason for refusals. The old code list (d) was overridden for this.
Memo D: callback window changed from 09:00-20:00 to 09:00-18:30 inclusive. Days are still today or the next two business days and must be later than now.
Callbacks are business days only: calls run only on business days, the next two business days are business days by definition, and the memo forbids booking on 11 Dec.
Memo confirms the floor stays at 30% (rule 17) and the limit stays at two wrong answers in total (rule 9).

Floor = 30% of arrears_amount, rounded up to the next whole pound. An amount that is already a whole number of pounds is not rounded. The floor is never the monthly_payment field. If rounding up would push the floor above arrears_amount (very small debts), the floor is capped at arrears_amount.
get_account amounts are in pounds (amount_scale 1). create_promise takes amount_pence, so promise_scale is 100 (e.g. £87.50 -> 8750).

Early band deadline: 8th business day after today, today not counted. Mid: today + 14 calendar days, moved back to the previous business day if it falls on a weekend or holiday. Late: last business day of the current month, rolled to the last business day of next month if today is already that day.

Rule 20 counts the opening ask (step 1: full arrears_amount today, first_ask='today') as attempt 1. The band attempts field holds only the follow-on proposals, which is total minus 1: early 0, mid 1, late 2. The ladder holds only steps 2 and 3, and the opening ask is never repeated.

Ladder attempt 1 (policy step 2): the full amount on the 5th business day after today, or the deadline if that is earlier (the engine caps ladder dates at the product's deadline). It is full_or_floor because of rule 21: after 'too much', the next step proposes the floor on that step's date. Ladder attempt 2 (policy step 3): the floor on the deadline.
Attempts are never more than the band's number. Early band: the opening ask uses its only attempt. Mid: one follow-on step. Late: two follow-on steps. No discounts, waivers or plans.
Two products: the joint 'pay both in full today' question counts as step 1 for each product. Products are then handled one at a time in get_account order.
Hardship: the agent says one sentence of sympathy and tells the customer they are being passed to the care team (queue care_team), then closes handoff/care. No note is written on any transfer.
Requests for a person: the agent asks once if it can help, then transfers to customer_care and closes handoff/human. Payment plan requests go to arrears_solutions, close handoff/restructure.
no_ptp close reason = note reason of the first product (get_account order) not noted 'paid'.
create_promise failing twice for a product -> record_failed line, note system_error.
The text-message payment link was dropped (email), so sms_line is empty.
Postcode length varies, so no fixed length is set. It is formatted in capitals with one space before the last three characters. Date of birth is sent as DDMMYYYY.

The verify_identity response has no hint field (only ok, error, verified, wrong_answers_left, all_verified), so identity.response.hint is empty and hints is empty. An unreadable answer returns ok=false and is not counted as wrong.

Brief silent, defaults used: next_weekday=following_week, purpose_is_decline=true, question_is_decline=false, refuse_deadline_is_refusal=true, ask_anything_else=true, clamp_single_date=true, max_not_talk=2, promise changes not possible on this call.
Rule 2 requires saying that the call is recorded; the opening says 'We record this call'.
The brief's 'floor' is spoken as 'minimum amount' for all product types.
No rule for days_in_arrears outside 1-60 (scope says calls are only for 1-60 days), so bands_outside is null.
